implemented: One stable switchable wire handle keeps existing models attached to the freshly paired or restored client.
Unary requests now use payload.args, stream requests use top-level args, responses enforce echoed rpcId, and successful void returns map to NullValue.
Remote Event answers carry Host ready.clientId and outcome; waterfall fields come from request and cancel frames retire pending cards.
Session follow and Remote Event streams retry after carrier loss; the next authoritative snapshot or ready frame replaces the old generation state.
Every HTTPS URL connection installs a pin-only trust manager and a second SPKI-verifying hostname verifier before opening the request body.

Android test source covers stable fresh-pair replacement, canonical envelopes, void RPC, ready/outcome/cancel, interaction reconnect, follow recovery, right pin, wrong pin, and zero handler bytes on a rejected handshake.

Official Gradle 8.14 distribution downloads were reset by the host network; no wrapper or lockfile workaround was added.
The real Host pair-to-reconnect corpus remains absent; G1-E2E must execute it before G1-ANDROID can become PASS.
